name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist | HubSpot & CRM Implementation, Time-to-Value, Adoption
summary: Customer onboarding and implementation consultant with 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments, and 5+ years building CRM and marketing automation systems, including hands-on HubSpot client builds. Onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets while leading a team of 8 to 20 specialists, and scoped CRM implementations and API integrations for C-suite buyers at Accelo. Today designs CRM architectures, integrations (Zapier, Make, n8n with custom Python/JavaScript steps), and AI-driven workflows for B2B clients, translating business goals into configurations that reach value fast.

bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, running discovery with business owners, translating requirements into CRM configurations, and delivering hands-on training.
Architect and implement CRM systems in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead routing, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Build integrations between client CRMs, CMS platforms, and third-party tools in Zapier, Make, and n8n, writing custom Python and JavaScript code steps for production workflows.
Designed and deployed 20+ automation workflows spanning lead capture, qualification, booking, onboarding nurture, reactivation, and review generation.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' goals into structured AI prompts and agent logic, and use AI tools daily to speed up audits, troubleshooting, and delivery.
Identify expansion opportunities with existing clients, scoping complementary services tied to their growth objectives.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led multi-stakeholder client accounts across paid media, inbound, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, presenting recommendations and quarterly business reviews to client leadership.

Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration, including Birdeye's listings-syndication solution for every partner's end customers.
Built scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (contracts ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Fed structured, high-priority customer feedback to Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, managing pipeline in HubSpot and coordinating delivery across teams.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between client-facing and delivery teams.

Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations alongside implementation teams, resolving technical issues during setup.
